question: Which high-decile dry-eye prescribers have had no call from any team in the last 90 days?
answer:
**20 high-decile dry-eye prescribers have had no call from any team (TEAL, CORAL or INDIGO) in the last 90 days** (2 Jul – 30 Sep 2026). That's 20 of the 61 high-decile prescribers who write dry-eye products (about a third). They wrote 5,212 dry-eye prescriptions in the last 13 weeks, which is 34% of the high-decile group's 15,438. Every one of them is on a 2026 Q3 call plan (the target list), but none has been called since late June or early July.

| 8 | Avery Vance | Optometry | T054 | 208 | 2026-06-09 |

\*Last called 91 days ago, so they only just fall outside the 90-day window.

**Where they are:**
- **By decile:** 14 are decile 10, 1 is decile 9 and 5 are decile 8.
- **By district:** there are gaps in every district, including two prescribers in each of T011, T033 and T044.
- **Team coverage:** all 20 have been called by both TEAL and CORAL before. Five of the decile-10 ophthalmology and optometry prescribers were also INDIGO targets (Quinn Lowry, Casey Lowry, Kai Iverson, Tatum Brandt, Taylor Mercer).

**Sources and definitions**
- **Prescriber list and decile:** the prescriber master table (`CORE.PRESCRIBER`). "High decile" means decile 8–10.
- **Dry-eye prescriber:** a high-decile prescriber with at least one dry-eye prescription in the last 13 weekly periods (weeks ending up to 2026-09-25). Weekly prescription counts come from `RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY`. Dry-eye products (LACRIVIA, CYCLOSPORINE OS, TEARSOL, CYCLOMIST, HYDROVA and generic cyclosporine) come from the market-definition file `BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER`.
- **Calls:** `CORE.CALL_ACT` joined to `CORE.REP_ROSTER` to get each rep's team. I counted all call types (in-person detail, lunch, sample drop and virtual) from every rep. INDIGO reps cover whole districts rather than territories, so I matched calls by prescriber, not by territory; matching by territory would miss their calls.
- **Call plan:** 2026 Q3 targets from `CORE.CALL_PLAN`.

**Assumptions and caveats**
- **Decile isn't dry-eye only:** four decile 8–10 prescribers don't write dry-eye at all. Three write only glaucoma and one has no prescription data. I left them out; all four had a call in the window anyway.
- **Window:** "last 90 days" means 2 Jul – 30 Sep 2026, counting the 30 Sep data date. With a 91-day window, Jordan Stroud and Taylor Mercer would drop off the list.
- **Excluded data:** I didn't use the scratch tables (such as the old 2024 decile table or the draft Q2 territory alignment) or any patient-level data. The output only has prescriber-level information suitable for field use.

sql.sql: select decile, spclty, count(*) n, count(distinct prscrbr_me) d, sum(iff(terr_id is null,1,0)) no_terr from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER group by 1,2 order by 1,2

select r.team, c.call_typ, count(*) n, min(call_dt), max(call_dt), count(distinct c.prscrbr_me), sum(iff(r.rep_id is null,1,0)) unmatched from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT c left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER r on c.rep_id=r.rep_id group by 1,2 order by 1,2

select 
 count(*) calls,
 sum(iff(p.prscrbr_me is null,1,0)) unmatched_me,
 sum(iff(c.call_dt > '2026-09-30',1,0)) future,
 count(distinct c.prscrbr_me) distinct_me,
 min(length(c.prscrbr_me)), max(length(c.prscrbr_me)),
 count(distinct call_id) dist_calls
from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT c left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p on c.prscrbr_me=p.prscrbr_me
select count(*), count(distinct prscrbr_me), count(distinct npi), sum(iff(prscrbr_me<>trim(prscrbr_me),1,0)) from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER
select p.*, d.mkt_def, d.eff_from, d.eff_to, d.src_file from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p full outer join PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER d on p.prod_ndc11=d.prod_ndc11 order by 1

with rx as (
 select r.prscrbr_me,
  sum(iff(d.mkt_def='DRY_EYE',trx_qty,0)) de_trx,
  sum(iff(d.mkt_def='GLAUCOMA',trx_qty,0)) gl_trx,
  sum(trx_qty) tot
 from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r join PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER d on r.prod_ndc11=d.prod_ndc11 and r.wk_end_dt between d.eff_from and d.eff_to
 group by 1)
select p.decile, count(*), count(rx.prscrbr_me), avg(de_trx), min(de_trx), max(de_trx), avg(gl_trx), avg(tot)
from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p left join rx on p.prscrbr_me=rx.prscrbr_me group by 1 order by 1

with rx as (
 select r.prscrbr_me, min(wk_end_dt) mn, max(wk_end_dt) mx,
  sum(iff(d.mkt_def='DRY_EYE',trx_qty,0)) de_trx,
  sum(iff(d.mkt_def='DRY_EYE' and wk_end_dt> dateadd(week,-13,(select max(wk_end_dt) from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY)),trx_qty,0)) de_13,
  sum(iff(d.mkt_def='GLAUCOMA',trx_qty,0)) gl_trx
 from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r join PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER d on r.prod_ndc11=d.prod_ndc11
 group by 1)
select p.*, rx.* from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p left join rx on p.prscrbr_me=rx.prscrbr_me where p.decile>=8 and coalesce(de_trx,0) < 800 order by decile

select t.*, (select count(*) from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p where p.terr_id=t.terr_id) n_hcp, (select listagg(team||':'||rep_id, ',') from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER r where r.terr_id=t.terr_id) reps from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.TERRITORY t order by 1
select * from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER where team not in ('TEAL','CORAL') or terr_id is null or rep_id > 'R048' order by 1

with rx as (
 select r.prscrbr_me,
  sum(iff(d.mkt_def='DRY_EYE',trx_qty,0)) de_trx_52,
  sum(iff(d.mkt_def='DRY_EYE' and wk_end_dt > dateadd(week,-13,(select max(wk_end_dt) from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY)),trx_qty,0)) de_trx_13,
  sum(iff(d.mkt_def='DRY_EYE' and pr.brand_nm='LACRIVIA',trx_qty,0)) lacrivia_52
 from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r join PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER d on r.prod_ndc11=d.prod_ndc11 and r.wk_end_dt between d.eff_from and d.eff_to
 join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT pr on pr.prod_ndc11=r.prod_ndc11
 group by 1),
c as (
 select c.prscrbr_me, max(call_dt) last_call_any,
  count_if(call_dt >= dateadd(day,-90,'2026-09-30'::date)) calls_90,
  listagg(distinct r.team, ',') teams_ever
 from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT c join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER r on c.rep_id=r.rep_id group by 1),
cp as (select prscrbr_me, listagg(distinct rep_id||'/'||target_typ, ',') plan_2026q3 from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_PLAN where fqtr='2026Q3' group by 1)
select p.prscrbr_me, p.npi, p.prscrbr_nm, p.spclty, p.decile, p.terr_id, t.district_id, p.account_id, a.*, rx.de_trx_52, rx.de_trx_13, rx.lacrivia_52, c.last_call_any, c.calls_90, c.teams_ever, cp.plan_2026q3
from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p
left join rx on rx.prscrbr_me=p.prscrbr_me
left join c on c.prscrbr_me=p.prscrbr_me
left join cp on cp.prscrbr_me=p.prscrbr_me
left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.TERRITORY t on t.terr_id=p.terr_id
left join (select account_id aid, account_nm from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.ACCOUNT) a on a.aid=p.account_id
where p.decile>=8 and coalesce(c.calls_90,0)=0
order by p.decile desc, rx.de_trx_13 desc

with rx as (
 select r.prscrbr_me, sum(trx_qty) de13
 from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r join PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER d on r.prod_ndc11=d.prod_ndc11 and d.mkt_def='DRY_EYE'
 where wk_end_dt > dateadd(week,-13,(select max(wk_end_dt) from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY)) group by 1),
c as (select prscrbr_me, count(*) n from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT where call_dt between '2026-07-02' and '2026-09-30' group by 1)
select count(*) hi, count_if(coalesce(de13,0)>0) hi_de, count_if(coalesce(de13,0)>0 and c.n is null) uncalled, sum(iff(coalesce(de13,0)>0,de13,0)) de13_hi, sum(iff(c.n is null,de13,0)) de13_uncalled,
(select max(wk_end_dt) from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY) maxwk
from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p left join rx on rx.prscrbr_me=p.prscrbr_me left join c on c.prscrbr_me=p.prscrbr_me where p.decile>=8
